title: Archive a document
objective: Let the owner archive a document and unarchive it. POST /api/documents/:id/archive and POST /api/documents/:id/unarchive (owner only: a teammate gets 403 { error: 'owner_only' }, a non-member 404). An archived document carries archivedAt and leaves the library list and GET /api/documents, unless asked to show archived (libraryPage(store, userId, { showArchived: true }) or ?archived=1), where its row carries an "Archived" mark (data-testid="mark-archived"). Its share links stop working: GET /l/:linkId and the download answer 410 { error: 'archived' } with nothing about the document and no open counted, and the visitor page reads "This document is no longer available" (data-testid="unavailable"). Unarchiving restores it and its links as they were. Views stay readable on the document page.
acceptance: The owner archives and unarchives; a teammate gets 403
An archived document leaves the library unless archived ones are shown, where it is marked
Its links answer 410 with nothing about the document, and no open is counted
The visitor page says it is no longer available
Unarchiving restores the document and its links
plan_summary: archivedAt on the document (a schema change in data and summary), routes in api.mjs, a filter in listDocuments, a gate in the visitor routes and linkPage.
